data.change_summary: Resolved the pending provenance amendments by extending `ProcessParamsPreset` to carry denitrification fields end-to-end, wiring scenario materialization to use authored denitrification values instead of runtime defaults, replacing the self-referencing denitrification TODO in `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml` with formal `param_meta` entries, adding missing shrimp toxicology metadata for `tan_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l` and `no2_repro_full_suppression_mg_n_per_l`, and updating `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md` plus regression tests so the shipped summary stays aligned with the data.
outstanding_risks: `soft_acidic.toml` and `ro_like.toml` still do not carry per-parameter `param_meta` entries.
Substrate provenance coverage is still partial: shipped checks cover `colonizable_area_factor`, but other substrate indices and nutrient-charge fields remain unannotated.
Code-resident carbonate solver constants still rely on doc comments plus `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md` until the project adds a dedicated metadata registry for shared chemistry constants.

steps.description: Inspected the current provenance summary, process preset, shrimp preset, and preset-loader code to confirm the remaining amendments were the denitrification self-TODO and the missing shrimp full-suppression metadata.

Extended `ProcessParamsPreset` and its lookup/validation paths to carry denitrification fields, then updated `tank_scenarios::process_preset_to_params` so authored denitrification values propagate into runtime scenarios instead of falling back to `ProcessParams::default()`.

Replaced the denitrification placeholder comments in `crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml` with explicit provenance/confidence metadata, added heuristic derivation metadata for the corrected shrimp TAN/NO2 reproduction full-suppression endpoints, and updated `docs/PROVENANCE_STATUS.md` to reflect the now-shipped coverage.

Added regression tests that lock denitrification metadata coverage, shrimp suppression-endpoint metadata coverage, and scenario mapping of denitrification fields, then ran formatting and test validation.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_data -p tank_scenarios` passed; `tank_data` finished with 37 tests green and `tank_scenarios` unit/integration suites all passed.

New regression coverage passed for `presets::tests::shipped_process_priority_metadata_covers_denitrification_fields`, `presets::tests::shipped_shrimp_priority_metadata_covers_repro_suppression_curve_endpoints`, and `tests::process_preset_mapping_carries_denitrification_fields`.
